description.zh:
幂等Token，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。
description.en:
The idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

description.zh:
凭据提供商名称。

> 长度不能超过64个字符。
description.en:
The credential provider name.

> The name cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-credential-provider --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --credential-provider-id atp_01kr2cmj5gxxx4fvmls2e93dxxxxx --client-token client-token-example --credential-provider-name test_example_name --credential-provider-config '{"JwtProviderConfig":{"AllowedTokenIssuers":["https://test.issuer.com"],"ExpirationCleanupEnabled":true,"Expiration":900,"DerivedShortTokenEnabled":false},"OAuthProviderConfig":{"TokenEndpoint":"https://example.com/token","Scope":"example:test_01_example:test_02","ClientSecret":"client_secret_example_xxx"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateCredentialProvider --region cn-hangzhou --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.ExpirationCleanupEnabled true --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --CredentialProviderName test_example_name --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.AllowedTokenIssuers.1 'https://test.issuer.com' --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.Scope 'example:test_01_example:test_02' --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.TokenEndpoint 'https://example.com/token' --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.DerivedShortTokenEnabled false --CredentialProviderConfig.JwtProviderConfig.Expiration 900 --ClientToken 'client-token-example' --CredentialProviderConfig.OAuthProviderConfig.ClientSecret client_secret_example_xxx --CredentialProviderId atp_01kr2cmj5gxxx4fvmls2e93dxxxxx --method POST --force
